desc:
Fast, chaotic 7v7 rugby with full ragdoll physics. Smash into tackles, grab and slam ball carriers, fend off defenders, and throw backward passes to keep the attack alive. Score tries, kick conversions and slot drop goals to beat the other team.

Ragdoll tackles, shoves, grabs and fends
6-tackle sets, play-the-ball, scrums and drop-outs
Join a club and climb the ladder
Earn Bucks to unlock kits, trails, headguards and dances
Quick matches with a pre-game countdown

Pick a side, grab the ball and run it in!
